successor_constraint.name: PREIMAGE_BOUND_EDIT_PRESERVATION_CONTRACT
requirements: bind exact pre-edit path, source generation/commit and content hash
prefer patch/diff or structured edit operations for existing-file modification
declare touched regions and deletion intent/budget
verify unchanged-region identity or explicit semantic preservation invariants
require requested-feature tests plus regression/destructive-delta checks
require resulting changed-file set to match declared scope
never let task-local acceptance override preservation failure

hypothesis.statement: Patch/diff-based, preimage-bound editing materially reduces destructive whole-file hallucination relative to generated complete-file replacement.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Patch editing can still be destructive through broad hunks, stale preimages, fuzzy application, incorrect context or explicit deletion; patch format alone is insufficient.
hypothesis.falsifier: A clean non-provider mutation harness fails to reject unauthorized deletion, stale-preimage edits or unrelated-region corruption, or shows no meaningful safety advantage over whole-file replacement under matched tasks.
